reason.default: This is an automated message from {brand}.
reason.password_reset: You get this email because someone asked to reset the password of this account. If it wasn't you, ignore it.
reason.email_change: You get this email because someone asked to sign in with this address. If it wasn't you, ignore it.
reason.email_changed: Sent to your previous address, so a change you didn't make doesn't go unnoticed.

reason.campaign_test: This is a test of a campaign; subscribers get the final version.

reset.subject: Reset your {instance} password

resetSso.subject: How you sign in to {instance}

resetSso.note: If it wasn't you, ignore this email.
adminReset.subject: Reset your {instance} password
adminReset.lead: {admin}, an instance admin, sent you a link to set a new password for {email} on {instance}.
adminReset.note: The link works once and expires in 15 minutes. Your current password keeps working until you use it.
emailChange.subject: Confirm your new email for {instance}
emailChange.lead: {email} asked to sign in to {instance} with this address from now on.
emailChange.note: The link works for 24 hours. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email.
emailChanged.subject: Your {instance} email was changed
emailChanged.lead: The account that used {old} on {instance} now signs in with {new}. If you didn't do this, contact your instance admin right away.
twofaReset.subject: Two-factor was reset on your {instance} account
twofaReset.lead: {admin}, an instance admin, reset two-factor on your account {email}.

twofaReset.note.message: Sign in with your password and set up an authenticator app again before {date}. If you didn't ask for this, tell your admin right away.
